_doc: What each nightly visual smoke scene must show (visual_check.py; docs/ci/nightly-next-canary.md).
Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] fractions of the captured window (1000x640 points, CMUX_NEXT_TEST_WINDOW_FRAME).
edge: share of pixels with a visible step to a neighbour on a 640-px grayscale copy; text and controls
score about 0.02-0.08, an empty or flat area under 0.001. Changing a limit or a reference is a reviewed
change to this folder: there is no switch that skips the gate.
min_ssim applies only when references/<scene>.png exists (32x20 grid; same layout ~0.97, another scene 0.3-0.7).
distinct_from: a scene fails when its capture's distinct_box (right of the sidebar) scores max_scene_ssim or more
against a named scene's on the same grid, so a driver that captured the previous scene again cannot pass.

home.what: Home after launch: the left sidebar, the Chief conversation list, Chief welcome pane and composer, and Home's New Tab

sidebar.what: the sidebar's Home, App Store and workspace rows

composer.what: the Home composer under the Chief pane

new_tab.what: Home's New Tab page: its folder picker and Ask anything field

composer.what: a new agent chat (palette.newAgentChat, its docked pane zoomed), with its composer
the new chat's composer, left of its Inspector

transcript.what: an agent chat with one answered turn, in its own workspace (agent.openSessionWorkspace, then tab.focus)

sidebar.what: the sidebar, now listing the chat's workspace

prompt.what: the prompt's bubble, at the right of the chat

reply.what: the agent's reply, at the left under the prompt
